attention: Runs in its own VM (Kata Containers), only at a site with an amd64 box that has KVM; elsewhere it waits to be scheduled.
Reached only from the people mesh, at <name>-<project>.mesh.<zone>: sign in as admin with the password shown once.
The home folder is a volume at the primary site: it stays there if the app moves.
description: A Linux desktop in your browser, in its own VM: Selkies streams an Ubuntu desktop over one WebSocket.
limitations: Validated on a 16-core amd64 desktop with KVM, under kata-clh: the desktop, its browser and the home volume.
title: Workspace
